title: Development of a telemedicine platform for the education and transition support of trans* and gender-diverse individuals
summary:
The study aims to investigate whether a telemedicine platform (app) for supporting the transition process is feasible. It will examine how easy the app is to use, how it is used, and how its use relates to user characteristics such as age, gender identity, and well-being. Surveys will be conducted before, during, and after the platform is used. Following additional consent, an interview or focus group will be conducted to discuss experiences with the platform.

In addition, interviews or focus groups will be conducted with experts to discuss the potential further development of the platform.

interventions.name:
Feasibility study: Two-week use of an app, questionnaire survey at 14 time points (before, during and after the intervention; see below for endpoints)

optional participation in an interview or focus group

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-       Personal interest in a transition process or ICD-11 (V) or (G) diagnostic code HA60.0 for gender incongruence or ICD-10 (V) or (G) code F64.0
-       Age 18 or older
-       Proficiency in spoken and written German
-       Informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
-       Withdrawn consent
-       Acute severe psychiatric disorders, e.g., acute suicidal ideation, acute schizophrenia, antisocial personality disorder; severe cognitive impairments, e.g., dementia, severe intellectual disability
